!E-STHR15  # p.535 note: E-STHR is not applicable when D = 15
!E-STHS6  # p.535 note: E-STHS is not applicable when D = 6
!E-SSTHC50  # p.535 note: E-SSTHC is not applicable when D = 50
!E-STHRB9  # D9 is not a catalogue size (6 8 10 12 15 16 20 25 30 35 40 50)
!E-STHCB45  # D45 is not a catalogue size
!E-STHRB  # the hole diameter D is missing
!E-STHRBL15  # long sleeve only for the D marked * (12 16 20 25 30)
!E-STHCL10  # long sleeve only for the D marked *
!E-STHRN35  # p.536 note: E-STHRN is not applicable when D = 8 or 35
!E-STHCN10  # p.536 note: E-STHCN is not applicable when D = 10
!E-STHRBN35  # p.536 note: E-STHRBN is not applicable when D = 35
!E-STHSBN10  # no square flanged thickened type
!E-STHXRB8  # p.533 note: E-STHXRB is not applicable when D = 8
!E-STHXR35  # D35 is not in the end mounting table (8 10 12 15 16 20 25 30 40)
!E-STHMRBL25  # p.532 note: E-STHMRBL is not applicable when D = 25
!E-STHMR40  # D40 is not in the compact table (8 10 12 15 16 20 25 30)
!E-STHMRL10  # long sleeve only for the D marked * (12 15 16 20 25 30)
!E-SSTHWR35  # p.539 note: E-SSTHWR is not applicable when D = 35
!E-SSTHWS40  # p.539 note: E-SSTHWS is not applicable when D = 40 or 50
!E-SSTHWSL12  # p.539 note: E-SSTHWSL is not applicable when D = 12
!E-STHWRBL10  # slit long sleeve table starts at D12
!E-STHWRB6  # slit standard table starts at D8
!E-STHWXB10  # unknown slit type
